name: Stygian-Paean
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an ancient meteor crater in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
